assumptions_challenged: That MISEV2023 guidance alone is sufficient to demonstrate SGL-001 meets CMC/analytics gates
That an MCB/WCB, orthogonal QC panel, validated intact‑EV release assays, stability‑indicating potency assay, and reproducible GMP‑like batches already exist for SGL-001
That rodent intranasal biodistribution data can be bridged to larger species without matched intact‑EV assays and lot comparability data
That formulation/device compatibility for intact‑EV recovery has been demonstrated for SGL‑001
falsification_conditions: Provision of program‑specific documents demonstrating existence and characterization of a source‑cell MCB/WCB (provenance, master/working bank characterization reports)
Submission of SOPs defining the orthogonal QC panel (particle concentration/size, protein/lipid/marker panels, non‑vesicular particle controls) and evidence of their routine use
Analytical validation reports for intact‑EV release assays showing LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy, and orthogonality (reported data and protocols)
A stability study and a stability‑indicating, mechanism‑linked potency assay with demonstrated correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint (study reports and statistical analysis)
Three GMP‑like batch production records with release/stability/potency results and a comparability assessment across lots showing reproducible CQAs
Formulation/device compatibility study reports (ex vivo and in vivo) that demonstrate intact‑EV recovery with appropriate negative/orthogonal controls
strongest_objection: The supplied evidence is only MISEV2023 guidance and does not include any program-specific CMC, analytical validation, or batch/manufacturing data for SGL-001; therefore the central claim that the program meets required identity/potency/robust-release criteria (or is ready to advance formulation/bridging) is unsupported.
